# Dr. Sushant Kumar Sethi - Senior Consultant Gastroenterologist & Hepatologist

> Official medical reference profile for Dr. Sushant Kumar Sethi, MBBS, MD (Medicine), DNB (Gastroenterology), practicing in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.

## Professional Summary
- **Doctor Name**: Dr. Sushant Kumar Sethi
- **Specialty**: Gastroenterology, Hepatology, Advanced Diagnostic & Therapeutic Endoscopy
- **Experience**: 25+ years of clinical and academic medical expertise
- **Training Institutions**: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi; Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals, New Delhi; SCB Medical College, Cuttack
- **Key Roles**: Senior Consultant Gastroenterologist at Apollo Hospitals Bhubaneswar; Professor & Head of Academics, Department of Gastroenterology, IMS & SUM Hospital Bhubaneswar

## Clinical Specialties & Conditions Treated
- **Gastroenterology**: Acid Reflux & GERD, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Crohn's Disease, Ulcerative Colitis), Peptic Ulcer Disease, Chronic Constipation, GI Motility Disorders
- **Hepatology & Liver Care**: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD / Fatty Liver), Viral Hepatitis (Hepatitis B & C), Liver Cirrhosis, Alcoholic Liver Disease, Jaundice
- **Pancreatic & Biliary Care**: Acute & Chronic Pancreatitis, Gallbladder & Bile Duct Disorders
- **Procedures Performed**: Upper GI Endoscopy, Colonoscopy & Polypectomy, Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS), Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), Liver Biopsy
